comment: Variation of return_throw_to_inv-twoweapon-aklys-tossed-up-rejoins-valkyrie: dothrow.c return_throw_to_inv() 1892 and 1897. A debug Priest with the autoquiver option wishes for a boomerang, wields it, swaps it to the alternate weapon slot (x), and throws it west; it loops back and is caught (throwit() 1606-1608). addinv_before() autoquivers the returned boomerang into the empty quiver, so 1892 unquivers it, and because it left the alternate slot (wep_mask W_SWAPWEP) 1897 makes it the alternate weapon again.
